direction: Monochrome conformance folio for economic reliability testing
principles: Judge economic intent against observed movement, not receipt status alone
Progressively disclose configuration, execution, reconciliation, verdict, then proof
Keep the same economic intent visible across transaction retries
Use typography, symbols, borders, spacing, and inversion for status without hue
Label replayed Arc Testnet evidence truthfully and never imply Mainnet execution

semanticStatus.success: white text/symbol on black or neutral surface
semanticStatus.violation: black text/symbol on white inverted verdict surface
semanticStatus.warning: neutral text with ! symbol and structural emphasis

typography.display: Liberation Sans Narrow, Arial Narrow, Nimbus Sans Narrow, sans-serif

usage.display: Editorial thesis, section headings, intent, verdict
usage.mono: Labels, trace, intent identifiers, values, transaction and gas metadata

layout.composition: Centered ruled folio; editorial thesis; obligation specification; implementation and fault controls; progressive execution timeline; intent-to-receipt branches; reconciliation; inverted verdict; post-verdict proof; editorial explanation; collapsed qualification record

interaction.selection: Semantic buttons with aria-pressed within labeled fieldsets
interaction.reset: Available after a run starts; implementation/scenario change resets replay state
interaction.timing: Deterministic presentation pacing, explicitly not historical chain latency

patterns.hero: Four-line display thesis with compact product purpose and Arc Testnet verified-evidence label
patterns.experiment: Open typographic/rule-based specification and controls, no card wrapper
patterns.trace: Numbered timeline with presentation timestamp, state symbol, label, detail, and optional evidence status
patterns.intentVisualization: One intent branches to receipt rows and recombines at recipient balance delta/invariant outcome
patterns.verdict: White/black inversion for violation; near-black/white for preserved intent
patterns.proof: Post-completion receipt, event, and recipient balance corroboration with transaction details
patterns.qualification: Native details/summary disclosure below primary experience

accessibility.focus: Visible 2px white focus outline with 4px offset for controls and links
accessibility.stateCommunication: Symbols and text accompany monochrome treatment
accessibility.liveRegions: Polite trace/reconciliation status and completion announcement
accessibility.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion disables smooth scrolling and minimizes animation/transition duration
accessibility.responsive: Single-column narrative at tablet/mobile widths; identifiers wrap or truncate within controls
